title: 如何理智地训练你的狗?(上)
desc: 如何理智地训练你的狗?(上)

paragraphs.en: My family has never been closer to the brink of collapse than when we got a puppy.
paragraphs.zh: 我们家最接近崩溃边缘的时候，就是养了一只小狗的时候。

paragraphs.en: We spent hours reading articles and watching videos about puppy training, and were constantly arguing about the right way to potty train him or get him to stop barking.
paragraphs.zh: 我们花了好几个小时阅读关于幼犬训练的文章、观看相关视频，还一直在争论训练它上厕所的正确方法，以及如何让它停止吠叫。

paragraphs.en: Every new piece of information seemed to contradict what we'd already learned – never scold him!
paragraphs.zh: 每一条新信息似乎都与我们已经了解到的内容相矛盾——永远不要责骂它！

paragraphs.en: Scold him! – but one thing was certain: make one wrong move and you will ruin your dog and your life forever.
paragraphs.zh: 责骂它！但有一件事是肯定的：只要走错一步，你就会永远毁了你自己和狗的生活。

paragraphs.en: We had fallen into a common trap.
paragraphs.zh: 我们陷入了一个常见的陷阱。

paragraphs.en: "The No 1 mistake people make (when training) is thinking, I have to make my dog be perfect and sit all the time, instead of remembering why we got a dog and that we're meant to have fun together," says Amanda Gagnon, a zoologist, behavior consultant and dog trainer in New York City.
paragraphs.zh: 纽约市的动物学家、行为顾问兼训犬师阿曼达·加尼翁说：“人们（在训练时）犯的头号错误是，认为自己必须让狗狗变得完美，时刻都乖乖坐着，而不是去想想我们为什么养狗，以及我们本应和狗狗一起享受乐趣。”

paragraphs.en: Training is how a dog and a human learn to communicate with each other and build a relationship, says Gagnon.
paragraphs.zh: 加尼翁说：“训练是狗和人类学习相互交流并建立关系的方式。”

paragraphs.en: This is essential to a dog's safety and happiness, but it doesn't need to be a joyless chore.
paragraphs.zh: 这对狗狗的安全和幸福至关重要，但这不必成为一件毫无乐趣的苦差事。

paragraphs.en: We talked to experts about how to start training your dog – in a way that won't make you lose your mind.
paragraphs.zh: 我们和专家探讨了如何开始训练你的狗——而且是以一种不会让你抓狂的方式。

paragraphs.en: Between social media, Lassie reruns and basic perfectionism, humans can sometimes have unrealistic standards for dogs.
paragraphs.zh: 在社交媒体、《灵犬莱西》的重播以及基本的完美主义的影响下，人类有时会对狗抱有不切实际的标准。

paragraphs.en: "A lot of people get stuck on the Instagram-perfect dog that is always happy and never has negative emotions," says Alex Sessa, the owner and head trainer of Peach on a Leash in Atlanta.
paragraphs.zh: “很多人都陷入了一种误区，认为理想的狗狗就像Instagram上展示的那样，总是开开心心的，从没有负面情绪。”亚特兰大“牵绳蜜桃”（PeachonaLeash）的老板兼首席训犬师亚历克斯·塞萨说道。

paragraphs.en: But dogs are individuals with different personalities and needs.
paragraphs.zh: 但狗是具有不同个性和需求的个体。

paragraphs.en: Maybe you wanted a dog that accompanies you to the farmer's market every Saturday, but crowds make your dog feel stressed.
paragraphs.zh: 也许你想要一只每周六都陪你去农贸市场的狗，但人群会让你的狗感到压力。

paragraphs.en: That's not a problem, says Sessa – people just need to adjust their expectations accordingly. "That's still a great dog.
paragraphs.zh: 塞萨说，这不是问题——人们只需相应地调整他们的期望。“那仍然是一只很棒的狗。

paragraphs.en: There's nothing wrong with the dog that doesn't want to go everywhere with us," she says.
paragraphs.zh: 她说：“那只不想跟我们到处跑的狗没有任何问题。”

paragraphs.en: And expecting your dog to always be perfectly calm can lead to greater behavioral trouble down the road, says Gagnon.
paragraphs.zh: 加尼翁说，期望你的狗始终保持绝对平静，可能会在未来引发更严重的行为问题。

paragraphs.en: "When we don't give our dogs outlets to express themselves as dogs – meaning barking and running and being bananas in general – those needs get suppressed, and when that happens, it's like a powder keg that's going to explode at any moment," she says.
paragraphs.zh: 她说：“当我们不让狗狗以狗的方式来表达自己时——也就是吠叫、奔跑，以及一般意义上撒欢——它们的这些需求就会被压抑，而一旦出现这种情况，就好像有个火药桶随时都会爆炸。”

paragraphs.en: Whether you're bringing home a puppy or an adult dog, experts agree it is important to give them plenty of time to acclimate.
paragraphs.zh: 无论你带回家的是一只幼犬还是成年犬，专家们都认为给它们足够的时间来适应是很重要的。

paragraphs.en: "Don't jump into too much obedience right away," Sessa says.
paragraphs.zh: “不要马上就进行过多的服从训练，”塞萨说。

paragraphs.en: "We don't want the dog to immediately feel like we're barking commands at them and asking them to do a million things."
paragraphs.zh: 我们不想让狗狗立刻觉得我们在对它们大声下达指令，还要求它们做一大堆事情。

paragraphs.en: Adult dogs in particular can take up to three months to settle into a new home and show their true behavior pattern, says Ciera Moberg, a certified dog behavior consultant and co-founder of Instinct Dog Behavior & Training in Washington DC.
paragraphs.zh: 华盛顿特区“本能犬类行为与训练”机构的联合创始人、认证犬类行为顾问茜拉·莫伯格表示，尤其是成年犬，可能需要长达三个月的时间才能适应新家并展现出它们真正的行为模式。

paragraphs.en: The way your dog acts the first day you bring them home might be completely different than the way they act on day 30.
paragraphs.zh: 你把狗狗带回家的第一天，它的行为方式可能和第30天的行为方式截然不同。

paragraphs.en: Once your dog is comfortable and you have a better understanding of their personality – what they enjoy, what makes them nervous – it will be easier to figure out how you want to focus your training.
paragraphs.zh: 一旦你的狗狗感到自在，并且你对它们的个性有了更深入的了解——它们喜欢什么、什么会让它们紧张——你就更容易确定你想如何开展训练了。

paragraphs.en: Most people don't need to teach their dog as many commands – some trainers call them cues – as they might think.
paragraphs.zh: 大多数人并不需要像他们所想的那样，教他们的狗那么多指令——一些训犬师称之为信号。

paragraphs.en: "You only absolutely need two cues," says Gagnong. "You need 'sit', and you need 'come'."
paragraphs.zh: “你绝对只需要两个指令，”加尼翁说，“你需要‘坐下’，还需要‘过来’。”

paragraphs.en: Sit. When a dog is sitting, "there are very few behavioral problems they can exhibit," says Gagnon. "This is about getting them into a calm position."
paragraphs.zh: 坐下。加尼翁说：“当狗坐着的时候，它们能表现出的行为问题非常少。这是为了让它们处于一种平静的状态。”

paragraphs.en: To teach a dog to sit, say the word and then use a treat to get them into a sitting position, Gagnon says.
paragraphs.zh: 加尼翁说，要教狗狗坐下，先说出“坐下”这个指令，然后用零食引导它们摆出坐姿。

paragraphs.en: Usually this can be done by showing them a treat and then moving it over and slightly behind their head, so when they track it with their nose, their head moves up and back and their rear drops.
paragraphs.zh: 通常，你可以给它们展示一个零食，然后把零食移到它们头顶上方并稍微往后一点的位置。这样，当它们用鼻子追踪零食时，它们的头就会向后上方移动，而屁股则会下沉。

paragraphs.en: Come. A recall cue is essential for safety. "Teaching a dog to come when called is about preventing them from running off into the road or into a dog fight," says Gagnon.
paragraphs.zh: 过来。召回指令对安全至关重要。加尼翁说：“训练狗狗听到召唤就回来，是为了防止它们跑到马路上或者卷入犬类争斗。”
